description: This Java source file defines a Spring REST controller (NoteController) providing CRUD endpoints for managing notes in the application. It interacts with NoteService for business logic and exposes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: Spring REST controller providing CRUD endpoints for notes.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Returns a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request body.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified ID.
